artboards.title: What do you need help with?

annotations.text:
The live screener as shipped 2026-08-29, rebuilt element-for-element from its real stylesheet (Annum brand: #FF0055 accent, Manrope + IBM Plex Mono, 14px radii).

Top row follows the question flow. State is a hard filter, then 'What's your local area?' lets people check several counties (type-to-narrow when the list is long) — programs and rentals match any of them. The needs question is multi-select with the new labels: Finding a home / Staying in my home / Buying a house / Paying a utility bill. Picking 'Finding a home' adds the rental-preferences step: max rent is a ceiling, but bedrooms and bathrooms are floors — a studio seeker also sees 1-bedrooms in budget, never fewer options. The income step now asks for gross income (explained in plain words) with a Per year / Per month toggle; monthly entries are converted behind the scenes. Circumstances covers every program gate (veteran, age, disability, kids, crisis, not stably housed) and is multi-selectable.

Bottom row: results group by program type with population-fit programs ranked first; when someone is looking for a place, an Available rentals section of live photo-forward listing cards (30%-of-income badge, cheapest first) opens the results — see the wide Available-rentals board. Cards open a detail dialog; the housing plan collects picks and prints.

Restyle anything here — hand the canvas back and the changes get implemented in the real CSS.
